mapper.select: SELECT BNO, TITLE, REGDATE FROM FREE_BOARD_TBL WHERE TO_CHAR(REGDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY BNO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE FREE_BOARD_TBL SET TITLE = #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CONTENT = #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, YOUTUBE_URL = #{youtubeUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BOARD_IMAGE = #{board_image, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE BNO = #{bno} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT B.BNO, B.USER_ID AS userId, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.REGDATE, B.VIEWCNT, B.YOUTUBE_URL AS youtubeUrl, B.BOARD_IMAGE AS board_image, U.NICKNAME AS nickname FROM FREE_BOARD_TBL B JOIN user_tbl U ON B.USER_ID = U.user_id WHERE B.BNO = #{bno}

SELECT B.BNO, B.USER_ID AS userId, U.NICKNAME AS nickname, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.REGDATE AS regdate, B.VIEWCNT AS viewcnt, B.YOUTUBE_URL AS youtubeUrl, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE_TBL L WHERE L.BNO = B.BNO) AS likeCount FROM FREE_BOARD_TBL B JOIN user_tbl U ON B.USER_ID = U.user_id ORDER BY B.BNO DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT B.BNO, B.USER_ID AS userId, U.NICKNAME AS nickname, B.TITLE, B.REGDATE AS regdate, B.VIEWCNT AS viewcnt, B.YOUTUBE_URL AS youtubeUrl, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE_TBL L WHERE L.BNO = B.BNO) AS likeCount, (B.VIEWCNT + ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE_TBL L WHERE L.BNO = B.BNO) * 5)) AS score FROM FREE_BOARD_TBL B JOIN user_tbl U ON B.USER_ID = U.user_id WHERE B.REGDATE >= SYSDATE - 7 ORDER BY score DESC, B.BNO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
